def is_good(n, memo):
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    
    s = str(n)
    digits = [int(d) for d in s]
    
    # Check if digits are distinct and nonzero
    if len(set(digits)) != len(digits) or 0 in digits:
        memo[n] = False
        return False
        
    if len(s) == 1:
        memo[n] = True
        return True
    
    # Try removing each digit
    for i in range(len(s)):
        # Remove digit at index i
        d_str = s[:i] + s[i+1:]
        if not d_str: continue
        d = int(d_str)
        
        if n % d == 0:
            if is_good(d, memo):
                memo[n] = True
                return True
                
    memo[n] = False
    return False
